subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md diagnostics be accepted as a lint-only CLI surface first, or must normal skills list/check/status/Web surfaces also report skipped candidates before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main still lacks diagnostics, and the open PR implements a narrower lint command while the issue asks for warnings in normal CLI and Web skill visibility flows.

options.title: Require status/list visibility
options.body: Keep this issue open until skipped-candidate diagnostics are visible through the normal skills status path and at least the CLI list/check surfaces, then decide whether Web UI follows in the same PR or a tracked follow-up.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Treat a fixed skills lint command plus docs as the initial supported validation surface, then close only if maintainers explicitly accept that as sufficient for this issue.

options.title: Split follow-up work
options.body: Land the lint command as partial progress and open a narrower follow-up for status/Web warnings before closing this broader issue.

recommendation.title: Require status/list visibility
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until skipped-candidate diagnostics are visible through the normal skills status path and at least the CLI list/check surfaces, then decide whether Web UI follows in the same PR or a tracked follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across skills CLI, docs, parser extraction, and adjacent skill-loading ownership, making him the best available decision owner from the history trail.
